steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Why is everyone running away?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Attack her with Arts! Stop running!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: S-stop! She, she's coming this way! Stop her!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Where are all the others?! Why...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're the last one.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Aaaaah...!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Demon... S-someone save me...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...You planned to stop me like this?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: No, I... No...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You planned to stop me... like this?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Spare me! Please!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're not even worthy of being food for my Hannya.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Noooooo!!

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Holy... We haven't even launched our attack yet.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: She destroyed Reunion alone, in just two and a half minutes.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: She truly is a demon.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Just be glad that you didn't meet her five years ago. It's been a long time since I last saw her fight like this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What about the stragglers?

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: They've already been captured by our various squads.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: ...Madam Ch'en, Inspector Hoshiguma seems to be waving at you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Medic, come with me!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hoshiguma, what else did you ask those Reunion members?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I asked them if the warehouse was rigged.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If the entire warehouse is hooked up with explosives...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We'll throw them in, one by one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Nothing. Ah Faat made his way here after he was ambushed. Reunion originally was set up around here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, pull on the door's right side. I'll get the left.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...It seems to be jammed and won't budge. Let me try cutting a hole first.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No need, I'll just tear it apart.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (BOOOOM!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's open!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: XR02, tell me your location! XR02!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: XR02!

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Madam Ch'en... I hear fighting outside. The warehouse door... was busted open. It might be Reunion. I'll take care of it myself...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop, that's me! Don't hang up!

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Is that you, Madam Ch'en? That's a relief... I'm... all the way in the back.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That wound... what happened to your eyes?

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: I wasn't careful enough, got hit by Arts. Don't worry about it, it doesn't matter now. This... *cough*... is for you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Medic, staunch his bleeding!

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: No... Madam Ch'en, there's no need. I've already accepted...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Stop talking!

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: It's true. Do you see how many times I've been shot? I'm blind, and don't want to move anymore. I've had enough of the pain. I'm so tired.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Take it, Madam Ch'en... S249TA, F106.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: 49. I've memorized the location.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Details are on the paper. The intel about Reunion's infiltration was not sent to the other leaders, but just to one party... There must be a reason behind it. You must look into it, the sooner the better.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: *cough*... It was no easy task for me to get this... Anyway, Madam Ch'en, I didn't expect things to end up like this.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Even though I was finally able to make a contribution, I didn't think this would be how I did it...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: None of us did. Thanks to your bravery, we now have a chance to stop the enemy.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Haha... *cough*... I never liked Lungmen, and Lungmen never liked me.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: But now, I've finally managed to do something for Lungmen. Not bad for a bum like me, right...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're calling one of the Chung Shui Big Three a bum?

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Compared to you, Madam Oni, I'm nothing more than a bum.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: ...Madam Ch'en, how's Madam Oni doing? Is she still working as Inspector?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She is. She's been my partner for a long time.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, Madam Oni... is too honest and frank. No one in the gang... *cough*... dared to challenge her.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: But she is no match for those Lungmen moguls. Please keep an eye on her.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Don't let anyone demean her. I won't let those stuck-up plutocrats insult her because of her background!

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: This is the only favor I ask of you. Just one... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't worry about that. Hoshiguma is very strong. No one can hurt her.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: No matter how powerful, everyone has their limits.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The entire L.G.D. stands with her.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Good, that's a relief. Madam Oni, Madam Ch'en, I have no regrets now.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, are you still here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Am I a good person?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A few years ago, a bit hard to say. But now you are, without a doubt. Lungmen is proud of having citizens like you.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Hahaha... *cough*... Haha... a pathetic Infected can be a good citizen?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Some people in Lungmen are indeed obsessed with Oripathy, but you'd be better off asking Lungmen directly.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: How do I do that? Will a city answer me?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Heh. I will, on its behalf.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And it says, 'I don't mind.'

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ah Faat, you have always been - and always will be - one of Lungmen's best.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Thank you, Madam Ch'en. Thank you so much.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Madam Chen, there are two things I'd like you to relay to Madam Oni.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You should tell her yourself.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: What do you mean? Are you saying...

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: ...Boss?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's me. I'm right here.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, you should've told me sooner.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She chose to not say anything.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Boss, did I do a good job?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Not good enough. You can't call it a good job until you survive to see things through.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Well damn, haha... I've already used up my luck to have you carry me on your back, Boss.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anywhere you want to go? You always refused to tell me where you came from.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Here, Lungmen. As a matter of fact, I've never been to other cities. If possible, just bury me in that old place.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The hideout? But... that place is a complete wreck now, long deserted. To be honest, I'm not sure how I'd clean it up.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: It's okay. As long as I'm... with the others.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: Boss... Even though we've always been scared of you, we've also always... cheered you on.

steps.name: Informant
steps.text: We've always... cheered...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Same here.
